notes.subject: הודו ליהוה
notes.rationale: lit. 'throw to Yahwe' (root ידה, throw/cast) — idiom of giving thanks/praise.

notes.subject: bilong em i gutpela tru
notes.rationale: כי טוב lit. 'that/for good'; rendered as causal clause.

notes.subject: to ol man i rit o singaut
notes.rationale: imperative plural summons the congregation to give thanks.

notes.subject: כי...כי
notes.rationale: repetition of כי frames the two grounds for praise, kept as parallel 'bilong'.

translation: Ol singaut luksave long Yahwe, bilong em i gutpela tru, bilong khesed bilong em i stap olgeta taim.
